title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: Master Cassette -> 24bit/96kHz wav -> slight edit (fade-in, out, azimuth adjustment, and slight level changes for crowd noise) -> 16-bit, 44.1 khz wav (triangular noise dither)
source: Unknown Mic, Unknown Cassette recorder (mono)  Location:  Slightly too close to stage

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording but only a fragment of the show, leaving fans wanting more.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note that this tape sounds clearer than other circulating audience recordings, which is a plus for an audience source. However, the set is severely truncated—few songs are present and key on‑stage moments are missing—so the musical experience feels incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: The recording quality is praised relative to other audience tapes, but the show suffers from missing material and few songs, resulting in an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than comparable audience recordings, but only a short excerpt of the concert is captured.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The tape includes only a handful of songs and omits the memorable 'caught' interaction, making the set feel incomplete and disrupting the natural flow of the performance.
